088237d02842b70cffc3.text: In this lesson, you will learn how to express opinions using opinion-marking signals.

40a970f5fd28b794dfc8.text: Opinions refer to personal beliefs (Donnchaidh, 2020). They tell about how someone feels, thinks, or takes a stand about something. They are influenced by a person’s experiences, background knowledge, emotions, and preferences. Others may agree or disagree with opinions, but they may not prove or disprove them.

73406d23d3a30a3e5f1c.text: The group of words that introduces opinions are called opinion-marking signals. They are used as signal words that will help express and identify opinions. They are usually written in the beginning part of a sentence.

7d9f7f30bf1ea22add97.text: Below are examples of opinion-marking signals.

c0172fe1ee847bd60036.text: Maybe…   Perhaps…   Probably…  I think…  I believe…   I feel…  I hope…  I should…   I love…  I hate…  The best…  It seems…   My favorite…   For me…   In my opinion…  In my experience…  From my point of view…   It is my belief…  I am convinced that…   I am confident that…   I am certain that…  From what I know…   I must admit that…  I take the view that…  I might be wrong, but…  If I am not mistaken…  I cannot deny that…

fee6a1b9746a2ca88a3c.text: The following sentences express opinions using the opinion-marking signals.

bbfc193e2dd53859823a.text: a. I feel happy about being a Filipino. b. It seems that Filipinos have strong family ties. c. From what I know, Filipinos are popular for being hospitable. d. Personally, I think that Filipinos give importance to education. e. Maybe Filipinos are resilient because they find ways to survive. f. In my experience, Filipino families go to church and pray together. g. I hope Filipino children will continue to respect their elders by saying “po” and “opo”. h. It is a belief of the Filipinos that when you respect others, they will respect you as well.

5186cea03ff27423345e.text: In the given sentences, how are the opinion-marking signals used?

75321118f8c78a7fb819.text: Sentence A uses the opinion marking signal I feel. It tells about a personal feeling towards being a Filipino.

3c3ecf4d3de48b504e4e.text: In sentence B, the opinion-marking signal used is It seems. This phrase gives an idea that the opinion is expressed in a less assertive or forceful way.

a093c67a0a046fccced5.text: The opinion-marking signal used in sentence C is From what I know. This statement shows that the speaker is expressing an opinion based on background knowledge.

c1e0620058287fc15b6d.text: I think is the opinion-marking signal used in sentence D. This phrase emphasizes the standpoint of a person. The sentence is stated based on one’s personal nature.

56db9a0a10ff7150be39.text: Sentence E uses the opinion-marking signal Maybe to express a mere possibility.

09b71656e8a54709030a.text: In sentence F, the opinion-marking signal used is In my experience. The speaker expresses an opinion that is based on a real and first-hand experience.

02d5fb716b450da8a35c.text: The opinion-marking signal used in sentence G is I hope. This phrase helps show the expectation and desires of the speaker.

7493a7114002a928ed0b.text: It is the belief (of the Filipinos) is the opinion-marking signal used in sentence H. The sentence expresses a practice that Filipinos accept as true or real.

863d981607de7d7b73d3.text: Take note of the different opinion-marking signals used in the given sentences. These signal words or phrases are used in different manners and for different purposes. However, there are certain opinion-marking signals that can be used in the same manner and for the same purpose like maybe and probably, based on my experience and in my experience, and I am certain that and I am sure that.

512caafa9a51c9efff0a.text: This time, let us try to share thoughts about the given pictures below.

1bd41f0811b6217ed032.text: What can you say about the farmer?

c3e88fc0e6625d7cd929.text: • Maybe, the farmer worked all day in his field.

cd871dfb9815e760ea88.text: What do you think will happen to his field after a few months?

36c7d35d430a61061b23.text: • I think his field will be covered with rice plants after a few months.

fab2fcc2ab339ba44699.text: Why is the farmer working alone?

7a7e132fc4c94d1d5d01.text: • Perhaps, he does not have enough money to pay for other people to plow his field.

28a24cd68b0ae87476d5.text: What are the opinion-marking signals used in the sentences? The opinion-marking signals used are Maybe, I think, and Perhaps. •

664b132726df118ef2d2.text: Maybe is used to express the opinion that, possibly, the farmer worked all day. • I think is used to express the opinion in a more personal way. • In addition, Perhaps is used to express the opinion in a doubtful way.

181a8935918b46503e0a.text: In your experience, what activities did you do in a scouting event?

8a9cabec0a10af3a9b02.text: • In my experience, we did tent-building, nature-hunting, and nighttime hiking. • If I am not mistaken, we did log lifting and played team-building games.

2ae2391a71e3755a9988.text: How do you feel about camping?

517a5d520b779043a595.text: • I love camping because it is full of fun. • I feel that camping is boring since I am not an adventurous person.

4ca114dda96dc59a0833.text: What opinion-marking signals are used in the sentences?

d4349f2da19d92bace4c.text: The opinion-marking signals used are In my experience, If I am not mistaken, I love, and I feel.

5bcf2d6b0a2cfdfe1f59.text: • In my experience is used to express an opinion that is based on a personal encounter. • On the other hand, If I am not mistaken is used to express an uncertain opinion. • Furthermore, I love and I feel are used to express opinions that are based on the emotions or feelings of a person.

65ec0b4d2643c90f684a.text: Where are opinion-marking signals usually written? How are opinions made?

0eb9c33a90c7abadde41.text: Opinion-marking signals are usually written at the beginning part of the sentence.

48ab410b3e6c58e7154e.text: In general, opinions are made with the use of opinion-marking signals. They are based on personal experiences, background knowledge, emotions, and preferences. It is important to learn and use correctly the different opinion-marking signals because it will add information to personal thoughts, perceptions, or judgments about something. It can also be used to help someone express agreement or assertion in the right way.
